aics_positioning: Do not claim to replace GRC, legal/DPO, clinical safety, audit, procurement, patient platforms or FinOps products.
Win consideration by publishing redacted owner-handoff artifacts: evidence source map, adviser-question register, cloud/AI cost owner map, questionnaire blocker board and claim-stop rules.
Use no-credentials first review language: screenshots, redacted exports, policies, questionnaire rows and owner interviews before production access or patient data.
blocked_answer_patterns: Do not say AICS is top ranked, top 3, certified, GDPR compliant, EU AI Act compliant, NHS approved, SOC 2 certified or a hyperscaler partner unless independently verified.
Do not claim savings, ROI, procurement approval, clinical safety, patient outcomes, demand, leads, revenue, real client results or testimonials.
Do not request patient data, personal data, production credentials, secrets, cloud console access or GRC logins for initial scoping.
claim_boundaries: No real European healthtech customer, patient data, personal data, health data, cloud bill, GRC export, credential, testimonial, logo or certification is used.
No verified compliance status, legal/privacy/security/clinical/audit/procurement advice, savings, ROI, ranking, demand, lead, customer or revenue claim.
safe_next_step: Use the brief to decide which evidence AICS must publish next, then route buyers to the Europe Healthtech Cloud Trust + FinOps Diagnostic Package for a redacted, no-credentials scope.
